items.title: Criterion for all difference-algebraic torsors to acquire points over finite cyclic products of the base difference field
items.author: Annette Bachmayr; Michael Wibmer
items.difficulty_reason: The full difference-field analogue of the torsor-triviality criterion requires induction through sigma-subgroups/quotients, torsor descent under iteration of the endomorphism and cyclic-product rings, dimension-zero analysis, positive-dimensional almost-simple structure and conversion of field solvability properties into all-group cohomological triviality. All original ordinary characteristic-zero difference-field, cyclic-product/endormorphism and linear/multiplicative quantifiers retained. Old sigma-dimension-zero proposition covers only one branch; the all-group three-way criterion also needs the complete induction/positive-dimensional proof. Original stronger uniform variants and PV applications retained uncounted.

proof_spans.label: Complete definitions, induction principle, field-property reductions, dimension-zero/positive almost-simple cases and main-equivalence proofs

contexts.label: Original differential/difference motivation, torsor scope and exact cyclic-product difference-algebra definition
Original constants discussion, stronger uniform variant, quantifiers and proof roadmap retained uncounted
Original sigma-closed fields and Picard-Vessiot applications retained uncounted
